Expanding Transmission in PJM Provides Large Net Benefits

Michael Goggin

November 23, 2026

Consumer Benefits
, 
Transmission

Annual costs and benefits of each RTEP25 portfolio

In Spring 2026, the PJM Interconnection (PJM) published the results of its 2025 Regional Transmission Expansion Plan (RTEP25), highlighting the approval of three main portfolios of projects that represent a $9.3 billion investment in high-voltage (500kV+) transmission upgrades across its footprint.

This analysis primarily evaluates the costs and benefits of the three main portfolios in the RTEP25, finding that

with $8.70 in quantified annual system-wide benefits for every $1 invested in annual transmission costs, these transmission upgrades provide great value for ratepayers.
 The annual benefits of nearly $5.9 billion quickly repay the $9.3 billion investment in transmission. Additionally, the portfolios provide other benefits that are difficult to quantify, like hedging against uncertainty in fuel prices and load growth, reducing harmful pollutants, strengthening the transmission system’s resilience against routine outages and unexpected events, and increasing optionality for meeting future needs.
